statuses.partial: Built, with something missing (see the note)
statuses.na: Deliberately not on this platform (see the note)

features.name: Sign in and sign out
features.summary: Email and password sign-in, signing out, the first-run server screen on the app.

features.name: Create the first account
features.summary: Sign-up on a new install (open only while no account exists, unless REGISTRATION=open).

android.note: The app has no Create account: an account is made on the web or with just seed.

ios.note: Same as Android: the app has no Create account.

features.name: Two-factor sign-in
features.summary: The second step at sign-in: an authenticator code or a recovery code.

features.name: Set up and manage two-factor
features.summary: Turn it on with a QR code, new recovery codes, turn it off.

features.name: Where you are signed in
features.summary: List of devices, sign one out, sign out all the others.

features.name: Change password
features.summary: Current password, a new one twice, and a code when two-factor is on.

features.name: Sign-in alerts
features.summary: The switch for the email sent at every sign-in.

features.name: API keys
features.summary: Keys for bots, scripts and agents with chosen permissions, an end date and rotation.

android.note: Web only, by choice: API keys are managed on the web.

ios.note: Web only, by choice: API keys are managed on the web.

features.name: Accounts list
features.summary: Accounts by group with balances, credit use, small balance lines and the net worth summary.

ios.note: Accounts by group with their balances and bank: no credit-use bars, small balance lines or the net worth summary yet.

features.name: Add and edit an account
features.summary: Group, bank and number, currency and rate, credit limit, statement days, spendable switch, exclude from stats.

features.name: Archive and unarchive an account
features.summary: Hide an account without losing its history.

features.name: Adjust balance
features.summary: Set the balance to what the bank shows, or add or take away, as a transaction that reports ignore.

features.name: An account's page
features.summary: Balance, this month, its own transactions, balance over time and the balance after each row.

ios.note: The balance, facts, a balance chart with three ranges and the 20 latest transactions with the balance after each row: no this-month figures, search or paging yet.

features.name: Market exchange rates
features.summary: A suggested rate for a foreign amount on a date, and the currency list.

features.name: Rate history
features.summary: How the market rate of a foreign account's currency moved, 30 days to a year.

features.name: Cards
features.summary: Debit cards on a bank account and credit cards with a repayment account; a Card field on a purchase and a card filter.

features.name: Credit card statements and due dates
features.summary: The statement balance, what is left, the due date and a Repay button, worked out each time.

features.name: Transactions list
features.summary: The list by day with search, the type chips, paging and the totals line.

ios.note: Search, a type filter, paging, a detail screen and delete (to the trash) only: no date, account, category, tag or amount filters, no selection, no planned list.

features.name: Filters
features.summary: Dates, account, card, category, tags with any or all, payment method, need or want and an amount range.

ios.note: Type, date range (with quick ranges), account, category, tags (any or all) and amount. No payment method, card, needs or wants, or planned filter.

features.name: Add and edit a transaction
features.summary: Expense, income or transfer with account, rate, category, vendor, date and time, way of paying, tags, note and planned.

ios.note: Income, expense and transfer with amount, account, category, vendor, payment method, date, note and an exchange rate for a foreign account. No time, tags, card, items, location, receipts or planned switch (a future date is planned by itself).

features.name: Save and add another, and duplicate
features.summary: Keep the form open for the next entry, or copy a transaction.

features.name: Templates
features.summary: Start from a saved template and save a form as one; the Templates page to rename and delete them.

features.name: Bulk actions on selected rows
features.summary: Select rows, then change category, tags, vendor or payment method, or delete them; select all that match.

features.name: Trash
features.summary: Deleted transactions wait to be restored or deleted for good, singly or in bulk.

ios.note: Restore and delete for good one by one; bulk actions wait for tx-bulk.

features.name: Planned transactions and Mark as paid
features.summary: Something coming up that counts toward nothing until it is paid with the real day and amount.

features.name: Refunds
features.summary: Give money back for a purchase (whole or by item), or link existing income to a purchase.

android.note: Refund rows are tagged and shown; a refund cannot be made or linked from the app.

features.name: Split a purchase into items
features.summary: Items with quantity, category and tax (GST included or excluded) that add up to the amount.

features.name: Receipts and web links
features.summary: Photos and PDFs and web links on a transaction.

features.name: Mark a transaction on the map
features.summary: A pin and an optional place name, with place search by name.

features.name: Merge two entries into one transfer
features.summary: A suggestion card for pairs entered twice, and a manual merge when an entry has an exact match.

features.name: Transaction groups
features.summary: Bundle related transactions under a name and see what they add up to.

features.name: Export to Excel
features.summary: Download what the filters show as a workbook with a summary and a sheet by category.

features.name: Import a bank statement
features.summary: Read a bank's CSV, review the rows, assign vendors and categories, import as one undoable batch.

android.note: Web only, by choice: importing a statement is done on the web, where the rows are easier to review.

ios.note: Web only, by choice: importing a statement is done on the web, where the rows are easier to review.

features.name: Categories
features.summary: Colours, one level of sub-categories, need or want, merge, and the default Salary category.

features.name: Sort every category into need or want
features.summary: One dialog to sort all categories (or only the unsorted ones) at once.

android.note: Each category's kind can be set one by one in its form.

features.name: Tags
features.summary: Coloured labels that cut across categories, with merge.

features.name: Vendors
features.summary: Address, contact, local or foreign, currency, usual category and tags, merge.

features.name: A vendor's usual place
features.summary: A usual pin that a new transaction picks up.

features.name: Subscriptions and recurring bills
features.summary: Plans with a next payment, pay-from account, installments, reminders and varying amounts.

features.name: Suggested subscriptions
features.summary: Recurring spending found in your transactions, accepted into a subscription in one tap.

features.name: Make a subscription from a transaction
features.summary: Turn a payment you already made into a recurring plan.

features.name: Budget limits
features.summary: Per-period limits for categories with a warning percent, rollover and the summary by kind.

android.note: Monthly limits can be made, edited and deleted. The budget settings (period start day, warning percent) are changed on the web.

ios.note: Monthly limits: see, make, change, delete, move money between them with undo and history. No budget settings (period start day, warning level), no rollover choice per period, and no limits for set dates.

features.name: Limits for set dates
features.summary: One total for a stretch of dates, a monthly limit that runs between two dates, and repeating a finished one.

ios.note: Read only: limits for set dates are listed under the period their days touch, with days left. Not made, changed, repeated or deleted.

features.name: Move money between limits
features.summary: Move what is left in one limit to another for one period, undo it, and see the history.

features.name: Savings goals
features.summary: A target that follows a savings account or a log of amounts set aside by hand.

features.name: Month plan
features.summary: What you have, the bills still to pay by day and where the money runs out.

features.name: Salary split rules
features.summary: Rules that divide a salary between accounts and goals, each one manual or automatic.

features.name: Split a salary and the Pending screen
features.summary: Review, edit, approve or dismiss waiting salary splits; undo one.

features.name: Dashboard
features.summary: Available to spend, the month strip, spending by category, net worth, cash flow, budget and goals, coming up and latest.

features.name: Budget and goals card
features.summary: Per-period limits and goals with a meter, and the running limits for set dates.

features.name: Needs and wants, and 50/30/20
features.summary: Spending split by kind, and the shares of income against the 50/30/20 rule.

features.name: Money flow
features.summary: A Sankey of income into one total and out to spending and what was saved.

features.name: Credit used
features.summary: What is owed against each credit limit.

features.name: Cash flow
features.summary: Income and expenses per month, what was kept each month and kept in total, over 6 or 12 months.

ios.note: Income and expenses by month (6 or 12 months) and this month's income, spending and what was kept. No kept-per-month chart or running total, and no table view of the chart.

features.name: Compare
features.summary: One period against another: income, spending, what was kept and every category.

features.name: Trends
features.summary: Category by month, spending or income over 6, 12 or 24 months, as a table or stacked columns.

features.name: Net worth and what moved it
features.summary: How net worth changed over a period and the drivers that explain it.

ios.note: Only the dashboard's net worth card (total, assets, liabilities, 30-day change and chart). Not the Net worth page with a chosen period and what moved it.

features.name: Places map
features.summary: Where spending went, as circles on a map sized by spend.

features.name: Notifications
features.summary: The bell, the list, read and dismiss, and the switches for payments, budget and goals.

features.name: Email digest
features.summary: The switch to be emailed a digest of notifications, and a test email.

android.note: The switch and the email status are in Settings; sending a test email is not.

features.name: Push notifications
features.summary: Notifications delivered to the phone when something needs a look.

web.note: Web has none; the API has no push channel yet.

android.note: Needs a push channel in the API first.

ios.note: Needs a push channel in the API first.

features.name: Settings
features.summary: Account details, numbers display, templates switch, default account and the notification and security cards.

features.name: Short numbers
features.summary: Show large amounts as 1.23K with the exact amount a tap away.

features.name: Backup and restore
features.summary: Download everything you own as one file and restore it into an empty account.

features.name: Guides
features.summary: The in-app guides with search; on the app they are generated from the web's.

features.name: Install the app
features.summary: Add to home screen (web), or the app itself.

features.name: Offline page and cached app files
features.summary: A service worker keeps only static files; data is never cached.

features.name: Health check
features.summary: An unauthenticated endpoint for monitoring.
